answer.diagnosis: Many layer-1 units carry very large weights (|w| about 50-99) on one 3x3 patch: image rows 1-3, columns 1-3 in the top-left corner. That patch is far from the central blob, so it cannot reflect blob size. It is a spurious corner-marker feature. Units 1, 7, 11, 12, 14 and 16 have strong positive weights on the patch, and unit 19 has moderately positive ones. Units 3, 5, 8, 10, 17, 20, 23, 25, 30 and 31 have strong negative weights there. Elsewhere, the same units carry the genuine size detectors: centre-disc and ring patterns. Layer 2 mixes these units, so a bright corner marker shifts the logit independently of blob size. Fix: zero the corner-patch weights in every layer-1 unit. This leaves the centre and ring size detectors intact.
